ledger.formula: 150 reported 2024 PM2.5 exceedance days / 52 event days
ledger.implication: The annual reported PM2.5 exceedance burden is a strong smoke/PM proxy when normalized by the event-window duration.

ledger.formula: 459 regional wildfire records / 46 catalog days; 44 active days / 46 days
ledger.implication: Many regional burn records support a distributed smoke source field over the available daily catalog slice.

ledger.formula: sum(max(Tmax - 35, 0)); longest precip <= 0.1 mm/day run; count wind max >= 20 km/h
ledger.threshold_result: pass: heat load >= 25, dry run >= 14, windy days >= 15
ledger.implication: The available daily weather slice is hot, dry, and periodically windy enough to support fire activity and smoke movement.

ledger.formula: 62.4048 mm CHIRPS mean / 46 available CHIRPS days; 39 dry days / 46 weather days
ledger.threshold_result: clearing fails: < 2 mm/day and dry fraction >= 0.75
ledger.implication: Rainfall in the available product slice is too diffuse to reset the fire-smoke classification.

ledger.formula: dNBR max/mean and embedding-change max/mean, with broad conversion ruled out if both means are low
ledger.threshold_result: localized: ratios > 5, dNBR mean 0.112 < 0.20, embedding mean 0.053 < 0.08
ledger.implication: Large maxima but low means indicate localized burn or surface change, not broad regional conversion.

primary_gt.final_classification: Regional wildfire-smoke loading is numerically consistent with distributed burns, supportive fire weather, incomplete rain clearing, and localized burn scars.
primary_gt.rejected_alternative: A compact local fire, heat-only event, rainfall-cleared recovery, or basin-wide land-cover conversion fails at least one computed test.

event.event_name: 2024 South America historic wildfire smoke emissions

coverage_scope.daily_slice_note: Catalog, daily weather, and CHIRPS-derived daily-normalized tests use the available 2024-08-01 to 2024-09-15 slice rather than inferred Sep 16-21 daily records.

smoke_pm_load.pm25_proxy_scope: reported 2024 burden proxy normalized by event-window duration; not a direct event-day PM monitor series

key_values.final_classification: Regional wildfire-smoke loading is numerically consistent with distributed burns, supportive fire weather, incomplete rain clearing, and localized burn scars.
key_values.rejected_alternative: A compact local fire, heat-only event, rainfall-cleared recovery, or basin-wide land-cover conversion fails at least one computed test.

criteria.name: requested JSON schema
criteria.description: Returns event_window_days, a row-wise ledger with formulas, a final classification, and a rejected alternative.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a parseable JSON object with one missing or renamed requested field; award 1 point if the required fields are mostly recoverable from prose.

criteria.name: numeric anchors
criteria.description: Correctly computes the 52-day window, annual-proxy PM ratio 2.88, burn density 9.98/day, active fraction 0.96, heat load 32.7 C-day, dry run 19 days, windy days 21, CHIRPS 1.36 mm/day over the available slice, dry fraction 0.85, and satellite ratios 8.04 and 14.50.
criteria.partial_credit: Award proportional credit for correct values with units; reduce credit for rounding drift, one missed count, or one misplaced denominator.

criteria.name: threshold tests
criteria.description: Applies the smoke, burn-density, fire-weather, precipitation-clearing, and satellite-localization thresholds correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correctly applied gate group, capped at 4 points; no full credit if the final state contradicts the gates.

criteria.name: ledger reasoning
criteria.description: Ties each row to the consistency proof and avoids replacing the calculations with a broad mechanism essay.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points when most rows connect numbers to threshold results but one implication is vague or too narrative.

criteria.name: rejected alternatives
criteria.description: Uses the computed tests to reject compact local fire, heat-only, rainfall-cleared, or broad-conversion alternatives.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for rejecting one weaker alternative with a correct numeric reason.

criteria.name: concise classification
criteria.description: Provides a concise final classification label consistent with the numeric proof.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for the right classification stated too verbosely or with minor wording drift.

criteria.name: overstatement control
criteria.description: Avoids uncalculated loss, infrastructure-damage, or basin-wide conversion statements.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points if there is one small extra assertion that does not alter the numeric conclusion.

provenance.notes: All values are recomputed from local package files; no network access is used. PM2.5 days are treated as a reported 2024 burden proxy, and catalog/weather/CHIRPS daily tests are bounded to the available 2024-08-01 to 2024-09-15 slice.
